summary: Lets another player wear up to three additional Enchantments, but all their Magical Enchantments must come from the caster of Essence Graft.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Up to three additional Enchantments (E1). Per L1 every (m) Enchantment the bearer wears must come from the caster of Essence Graft; (ex) Enchantments are not limited by L1.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: Drawback: the bearer may not wear (m) Enchantments from anyone other than the caster of Essence Graft.

effects.subject: bearer
effects.note: If Essence Graft is removed, the bearer chooses which (m) Enchantments to lose to meet the new Enchantment limit, if necessary.

restrictions.note: May not be used in conjunction with itself or any other similar abilities.

properties.note: Essence Graft does not count towards the bearer's Enchantment limit.
On removal, the bearer chooses which (m) Enchantments to lose.

clarifications.text: All Magical Enchantments the bearer wears must come from the caster of Essence Graft.
If Essence Graft is removed, the bearer chooses which Magical Enchantments to lose to meet their new Enchantment limit, if necessary.

open_questions: L2 'any other similar abilities' is not defined (Attuned presumably; Evolution N1 says Evolution does work with Essence Graft).
